title: Documents persisted at module scope
description: Monaco models outlive viewers to preserve undo history and scroll position
body: One Monaco model per open path, at module scope rather than in hook state. `TextViewer` has no route to a hook's closure, and the whole point of the store is that a model outlives the viewer that mounted it — which is what makes undo history, cursor and scroll survive a tab switch. One Files frame per window, so one store.
